name: 張庭瑜
objective:
本課程主要在介紹企業的管理系統如何有效的計畫、設計和分析及實行，包括管理系統的分析、可行性研究、系統設計、系統發展、雛形設計、測試、文件製作和評估等。
The purpose of this course is to provide the students with a broad understanding of information systems, information technologies, information systems development and management in business and other organizations.
schedule:
Week 1	Course Introduction 課程說明、教學目標、評量方式、教材介紹
Week 2	Business Information Systems in Your Career 資訊系統的基本概念與管理層級（Ch.1）
Week 3	Global E-Business and Digital Firms 數位企業、商業流程與組織（Ch.2）
Week 4	Collaboration, Social Business, and Knowledge Management 協作系統與知識管理（Ch.2）
Week 5	Achieving Competitive Advantage with Information Systems
競爭策略、五力分析、價值鏈（Ch.3）
Week 6	Global Competition & Business Process Management
全球化策略、BPM 與流程再造（Ch.3）
Week 7	Ethical, Social, and Political Issues in Information Systems
資訊倫理、隱私與法規（Ch.4）
Week 8	IT Infrastructure and Emerging Technologies
IT 基礎建設、雲端與新興科技（Ch.5）
Week 9	Midterm Examination
Ch.1–Ch.5
Week 10	Data Management and Business Intelligence
資料庫、資料品質與 BI（Ch.6）
Week 11	Telecommunications, Internet, and Wireless Technologies
網路與通訊科技（Ch.7）
Week 12	Information Systems Security and Control
資訊安全與風險管理（Ch.8）
Week 13	Achieving Operational Excellence & Enterprise Systems
ERP、SCM、CRM（Ch.9）
Week 14	E-Commerce and Digital Markets
電子商務與平台經濟（Ch.10）
Week 15	Improving Decision Making and Managing Artificial Intelligence
DSS 與 AI 決策（Ch.11）
Week 16	Information Systems Development and Project Management
系統開發與 IT 投資（Ch.12）
Week 17	Group Project Presentations
分組專題報告
Week 18	Final Examination
scorePolicy:
